title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Agh sorry. My friend flew in from London for Thanksgiving and I got caught up with her. How was your thanksgiving?
No worries. Outside of the fact I’m unsure of my future employment, good
I wonder if Colangelo telling people he’s on a mission to get me fired has anything to do with it, though
Do you think the story could have had something to do with it?That timing is not great
Oh shit, I didn’t know Ron way on a mission like that
Yeah, clearly it’s not stopping me, though
Would you be able to publish it through the paper, or would you have to go a different route??
I mean, I don’t know if it’s quite that - Colangelo thing - but there’s shit going on
I wouldn’t put it passed any leadership here. I’m sorry though.Why would the paper be ok with that? You have great rapport with so many peopler in the office and league
There’s more layers to it, I’ll fill you in.
